hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason:
Do not run osascript directly: macOS files the permission under Claude's version number, so it asks again after every update. Use the proxy (one grant, asked once):
  ~/.mac-proxy/mac_proxy.py applescript '...AppleScript...'      ('-' reads stdin)
  ~/.mac-proxy/mac_proxy.py jxa '...JXA...'
  ~/.mac-proxy/mac_proxy.py screenshot /absolute/path.png [screencapture options]
  ~/.mac-proxy/mac_proxy.py run COMMAND ARGS...                  (any other command that needs the proxy's grants)
  --timeout SECONDS goes before the verb; from Python use `from mac_proxy import call`.
